after.description: [GO, UP, MX] Live Preview of Content in CMS — Content editors must be able to see a live preview of their draft/unpublished content changes in the application before publishing, so they can verify how content renders on the actual site.
after.title: [GO, UP, MX] Live Preview of Content in CMS

notes: Novel capability — Live Preview does not exist in the codebase. The attachment point is useContent (236 callers), the single funnel through which all Contentstack content flows. No component-level changes are needed; the hook/provider layer must be extended to support preview mode. VCs derived solely from the description since ACs are empty.
